bugs_found: transfer does not normalize amount to Decimal, so floats/custom numeric objects can pass validation and then fail or behave inconsistently during balance mutation
transfer is not atomic: account_from.balance is debited before account_to.balance is credited, so an exception during credit can leave balances inconsistent
no validation rejects non-finite Decimal values such as NaN or Infinity in amounts/rates/balances, causing exceptions or nonsensical financial results
compound_interest silently truncates years and compounds_per_year with int(), changing behavior for fractional inputs instead of rejecting invalid periods
loan_payment silently truncates months with int(), accepting fractional month inputs with undeclared semantics
fx_convert accepts zero or negative FX rates, allowing zero/negative converted amounts despite only validating input amount
